messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.1

1.3.8.1. Moving transmission parts Guards designed to protect persons against the hazards generated by moving transmission parts shall be: (a) either fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1; or (b) interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2. Interlocking movable guards shall be used where frequent access is envisaged.

response.text:
Guards protecting persons against hazards from moving transmission parts | shall be | fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1 | one of two alternatives, the other being interlocking movable guards | "either fixed guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.1"
Guards protecting persons against hazards from moving transmission parts | shall be | interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2 | one of two alternatives, the other being fixed guards | "or (b) interlocking movable guards as referred to in section 1.4.2.2"
Interlocking movable guards | shall be used | where frequent access is envisaged | | "Interlocking movable guards shall be used where frequent access is envisaged."
